description: Least privilege for the BNO Tracker. Filesystem access is confined to the app's own data folder ($APPDATA) - the tracker never reads or writes anywhere else. dialog is for the JSON/CSV export and import pickers. opener is only reachable through openExternal() in index.html, which is limited to the gov.uk guidance link and the source-code link. No shell, no http, no fetch: with Chart.js gone this app makes no network requests at all, and that is enforced here as well as by the CSP.
